levels.surface: طلحة بن عبد الله بن عوف

notes: Two isnads with the same story (praying behind Ibn Abbas), written one after the other with no «ح», so two groups. The second adds the funeral recitation and «ليعلموا أنها سنة».
«صليت خلف ابن عباس» puts Ibn Abbas in the scene only; he is not a link. Talha is the last link in both.
